= IBM watsonx.ai
:artifactid: camel-ibm-watsonx-ai-starter

Generate text, chat, embed, rerank and tokenize text, extract and classify documents, detect harmful content and forecast time series with the foundation models and deployments of IBM watsonx.ai.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::ibm-watsonx-ai-component.adoc[IBM watsonx.ai component], URI syntax: `ibm-watsonx-ai:label`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-ibm-watsonx-ai-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
